plainText:
Going Ashore and Neighboring Akala Island (Japanese: 上陸！！となりのアーカラじま！ Disembarking!! The Neighboring Akala Island!) is the eighth chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
receives from Professor Kukui.
receives a task to deliver special Mirage Berries to each of Alola's guardian deities, which he accepts after learning he will be paid.
Hala is revealed to have taken Sun's Sparkling Stone in order to fix it into something.
The is revealed to be the Moon transported to Alola after it combined with a spare Pokédex.
Moon takes the Rotom Pokédex for herself while Sun is given his usual Pokédex back.
Gladion travels to the Ruins of Conflict, only to find Guzma there instead of .
Guzma enlists Gladion as a member of Team Skull as an Enforcer.
Sun, Moon, and Professor Kukui arrive at Heahea City on Akala Island.
Professor Kukui heads off to talk to his wife, Professor Burnet.
Sun and Moon meet Lana, Kiawe, and Mallow, the Trial Captains of Akala Island.
Kiawe challenges Sun to a battle to see if he's worthy enough of doing the island challenge.
The battle ends without a winner, but Kiawe accepts Sun.
Lana, still unconvinced about Sun, tells everyone to follow her to Brooklet Hill.
